record.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the political strategies and philosophy of Gopal Krishna
    Gokhale and select the correct answer/answers:
     1. He founded the Servants of India Society in 1905 to train national missionaries for the service
         of the country.
     2. He advocated for the complete boycott of British legislative institutions and legal structures to
         demand immediate self-rule.
     3. He worked inside the Imperial Legislative Council to expose the fiscal imbalances and high
         military expenditures of the colonial government.

There shall be negative marking for all Objective/MCQ type questions. For each incorrect answer in the MCQ, one-third (1/3rd) of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted.
